from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Nature of Light Speed", 
                          ["Light speed changes in different materials.", 
                           "Air is fast, water is slower.", 
                           "This speed change causes bending."])
        
        # Load Assets
        glass_asset = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/glass.svg")
        speedometer_asset = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/speedometer.svg")
        
        # Setup visual elements
        self.place_at_grid(glass_asset, 'C4', scale_factor=0.5)
        
        # Pulse
        pulse = Circle(radius=0.3, color="#00FFFF").set_fill(color="#00FFFF", opacity=0.8)
        self.place_in_area(pulse, 'A4', 'C6', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        # Speedometer
        speed_text = Text("Speed:", font_size=20)
        speed_val = DecimalNumber(100, num_decimal_places=0, color="#00FFFF")
        speedometer_group = VGroup(speedometer_asset, speed_text, speed_val).arrange(DOWN)
        self.place_at_grid(speedometer_group, 'D5', scale_factor=0.7)
        
        # Label for speed value
        speedometer_label = Text("Speed Value:", font_size=18, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(speedometer_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.play(FadeIn(pulse), FadeIn(glass_asset), FadeIn(speedometer_group), Write(speedometer_label))
        # Move pulse to boundary (glass)
        self.play(pulse.animate.move_to(self.grid['B4']), run_time=3)
        self.wait(3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FF00FF")
        # Pulse enters slower medium, change speed
        speed_val.add_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(60))
        self.play(
            pulse.animate.move_to(self.grid['C4']), 
            run_time=4, 
            rate_func=linear
        )
        speed_val.remove_updater(lambda d: d.set_value(60))
        self.wait(3)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFFF00")
        # Bending indication
        bend_arrow = Arrow(start=self.grid['C4'], end=self.grid['E6'], color="#FFFF00")
        self.play(Create(bend_arrow))
        self.wait(4)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Snell's Law explains light bending.",
            "The Normal line is perpendicular.",
            "Light slows and bends toward it.",
            "Entering glass, the angle closes.",
            "It bends away when exiting."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Physics of Refraction (Snell’s Law)", lecture_lines)

        # Assets
        glass_asset = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/glass.svg")
        
        # Define graphical elements
        normal = DashedLine(start=[0, 2, 0], end=[0, -2, 0], color=GRAY)
        
        incident_ray = Line(start=[-2, 1.5, 0], end=[0, 0, 0], color="#FFD700")
        theta1 = MathTex(r"\\theta_1", color="#FFD700")
        
        refracted_ray = Line(start=[0, 0, 0], end=[1.5, -1.2, 0], color="#00FF00")
        theta2 = MathTex(r"\\theta_2", color="#00FF00")
        
        snell_eq = MathTex(r"n_1 \\sin(\\theta_1) = n_2 \\sin(\\theta_2)", font_size=36)
        
        # Grid positioning
        self.place_at_grid(glass_asset, 'C4', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(normal, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(incident_ray, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(refracted_ray, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.place_at_grid(theta1, 'B3', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(theta2, 'E3', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_in_area(snell_eq, 'C4', 'D6', scale_factor=0.9)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))
        self.play(Create(incident_ray), Write(theta1))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.play(Create(normal), FadeIn(glass_asset))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))
        self.play(Create(refracted_ray), Write(theta2))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))
        self.play(Write(snell_eq))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FFFFFF"))
        self.play(Indicate(snell_eq))
        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: The Bending Path: Understanding Light Refraction

sections.title: The Hook: The Broken Straw Illusion
sections.content: Introduce the phenomenon by showing a straw in a glass of water. Explain that light travels in straight lines in a vacuum, but changes direction when crossing boundaries between different media.
sections.example: A 'thirsty' cartoon character observes their straw looking bent at the water line, sparking the investigation into why.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Nature of Light Speed
sections.content: Define 'Optical Density'. Briefly explain that light travels at different speeds in different materials (Fast in air, slower in water/glass). Use a visual analogy of a car moving from pavement to mud.
sections.example: A marching band transitioning from a smooth floor (air) to thick grass (water) causes the rows to pivot and change direction.

sections.title: The Physics of Refraction (Snell’s Law)
sections.content: Introduce Snell’s Law: n1 * sin(θ1) = n2 * sin(θ2). Use an animated graphic showing the 'Normal' line (perpendicular to the surface), the angle of incidence, and the angle of refraction.
sections.example: An animation showing a laser beam entering a block of glass, highlighting how the angle closes toward the Normal as speed decreases.

sections.title: Real-World Application: Predator Precision
sections.content: Explain how refraction affects perception. Because light bends, objects in water appear at a different depth than they actually are.
sections.example: A Heron (bird) hunting fish. The bird must aim slightly below where the fish appears to be to account for the light's bending at the water's surface.

sections.title: Summary and Concept Check
sections.content: Recap the relationship: Higher density = slower speed = bending toward the normal. Provide a quick mental exercise.
sections.example: Visual summary slide: A quick comparison table of Light entering 'Air to Glass' vs 'Glass to Air' with simple vector arrows.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The straw visualization is too vertically clustered in column 3, causing potential occlusion and poor visual separation. Fix: Line 55: self.place_at_grid(straw, 'B2', scale_factor=0.7); Line 67: self.place_at_grid(straw_broken, 'D2', scale_factor=0.7) (line=55, object=straw and straw_broken)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed cluster/occlusion issues by adjusting grid positions for straw objects.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The water_surface line is overlapping with the visual progression of the straw components. Fix: Line 63: self.place_in_area(water_surface, 'C1', 'C4', scale_factor=0.8) (line=63, object=water_surface)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed water surface positioning/overlap.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The label is placed at E5, which is too far from the central action area and lacks proximity to the related straw objects. Fix: Line 82: self.place_at_grid(label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.9) (line=82, object=label)
issues.resolution_note: Repositioned label closer to action area.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The 'pulse' animation currently obstructs the right side of the screen, creating a cluttered visual balance with the left-aligned text. Fix: self.place_in_area('pulse', 'A4', 'C6', scale_factor=0.6) (line=1, object=pulse)
issues.resolution_note: Pulse positioned in A4-C6 area.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The speedometer is placed too low (E5), making it feel disconnected from the central animation flow. Fix: self.place_at_grid('speedometer', 'D5', scale_factor=0.7) (line=2, object=speedometer)
issues.resolution_note: Speedometer moved to D5.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: Lack of visual grouping between the speed value and the pulse animation causes ambiguity. Fix: self.place_at_grid('label_speed_value', 'D4', scale_factor=0.5) (line=3, object=speedometer_label)
issues.resolution_note: Speed value label added at D4.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Snell's Law equation is positioned too low in the grid, causing potential visual imbalance with the refractive animation above. Fix: Line 71: self.place_in_area(snell_eq, 'C4', 'D6', scale_factor=0.9) (line=71, object=snell_eq)
issues.resolution_note: Snell's Law equation repositioned as requested.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Theta 1 label is floating too high and lacks proximity to the incident ray, risking confusion. Fix: Line 1: self.place_at_grid(theta1, 'B3', scale_factor=0.8) (line=1, object=theta1)
issues.resolution_note: Theta 1 label repositioned to B3.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: Theta 2 label position is slightly detached from the refracted ray, weakening the visual link to Snell's Law. Fix: Line 5: self.place_at_grid(theta2, 'E3', scale_factor=0.8) (line=5, object=theta2)
issues.resolution_note: Theta 2 label repositioned to E3.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The refraction animation (horizontal line and moving points) overlaps with the left-side lecture text, causing visual clutter. Fix: self.place_in_area(refraction_animation, 'A3', 'F6', scale_factor=0.9) (line=1, object=refraction_animation)
issues.resolution_note: Used place_in_area to position assets in columns 4-6 to prevent overlap with lecture text.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The Grid Visual section is shifted too far to the right, leaving excessive whitespace and failing to utilize the left side of the screen. Fix: self.place_in_area(grid_group, 'A1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.85) (line=2, object=grid_group)
issues.resolution_note: Updated layout logic to use 6x6 grid spanning full screen right side.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The 'Grid Visual' title is positioned too close to the top edge, creating a cramped layout. Fix: self.place_at_grid(grid_title, 'A2', scale_factor=1.0) (line=3, object=grid_title)
issues.resolution_note: Title handled by setup_layout using to_edge(UP).

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The formula and arrow occupy the center-right area, creating an unbalanced layout and potential visual crowding with the grid. Fix: Line 73: self.place_in_area(formula, 'B3', 'C6', scale_factor=0.9) (line=73, object=formula)
issues.resolution_note: Repositioned the refraction formula to B3-C6 area to prevent crowding.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The arrow element is placed too low (D5) relative to the formula (D4), causing a disjointed connection between the concept and the math. Fix: Line 67: self.place_at_grid(arrow, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6) (line=67, object=arrow)
issues.resolution_note: Repositioned the arrow to grid B4.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_5] Problem: The concept table is positioned too close to the formula, leading to overlapping visual weight and poor breathing room. Fix: Line 59: self.place_at_grid(concept_table, 'A4', scale_factor=0.5) (line=59, object=concept_table)
